description: This file provides utility functions for encrypting and decrypting string values using NaCl secret boxes, with support for base64 encoding/decoding and environment-based key retrieval.

methods.name: _get_salt_key
methods.description: Retrieves the salt key from environment variable or fallback to master key.

methods.name: encrypt_value_helper
methods.description: Encrypts a string value using a signing key, returns base64-encoded encrypted string.

methods.name: decrypt_value_helper
methods.description: Decrypts a base64-encoded string value using a signing key, with error handling and optional debug logging.

methods.name: encrypt_value
methods.description: Encrypts a string value using NaCl SecretBox with a SHA-256 derived key.

methods.name: decrypt_value
methods.description: Decrypts a bytes value using NaCl SecretBox with a SHA-256 derived key, returns plaintext string.
